this_week.title: The verdict changed
this_week.detail: ALERT: Niño 3 is above anything measured at +3.4 °C against the previous maximum +3.3, and water +11.3 °C above normal is sitting at 100 m depth at 125°W. World food prices are the highest in five years, with the FAO index at 133.3. CORRECTION (2026-09-06): The sentence about food prices was wrong. The rule compared the FAO index with the last 36 months only and called 133.3 a five-year high; the whole of 2022 was higher, with a peak of 160.2 in March 2022. What is true: the index, 133.3 in August 2026, is at a twelve-month high, the highest since November 2022, and 2.5 % above a year ago (130.0). The rule was fixed on 6 September 2026 and the alert is now WATCH, not SHOUT.
